# HAPI v0.36.7.2

## Compared with the previous maintained release

- Integrates the Cursor improvements for slash commands, permissions, model selection, account usage, portable conversation branches, and native history. Verified cross-host Cursor stores can resume through ACP. Native fork and conversation rewind require a compatible store and a verified history boundary.
- Shows Codex edits as per-file diffs on Web, iOS and Android. The Web composer can attach long pastes as text, and the session list highlights the open session and supports nested chat folders.
- Restores hosted transcript updates on iOS, preserves streamed Kimi ACP text, and fixes Windows OpenCode compaction and retry reporting.
- The Hub logs the start and completion of database migrations. Nested chat folders add two tables in schema 37. The schema-36 backup is required to roll back to 0.36.7.1.

## Compared with the official release

- Builds on upstream main `6f7420aa`, two commits past official v0.36.7, and preserves the previous maintained release's reviewed patches.
- Adds the Cursor integration from fork PR #36, the Codex patch display from fork PR #38, and the iOS transcript observation repair from fork PR #37. The release audit records the exact upstream heads and integration repairs.
- Ships the standalone CLI, Hub and embedded Web app in five platform archives with SHA-256 checksums. The macOS archives keep the `xyz.hapi.cli` signature identity.
